name: Court of Justice of the European Union

temporal: Competence is procedure-, instrument- and material-date-specific; this registry record does not back-project current treaty or procedural rules into earlier disputes.
territorial: Jurisdiction operates within the European Union legal order and the treaty-defined external or Member-State contexts relevant to the specific procedure.
personal: Standing and party capacity depend on the procedure, including Member States, Union institutions, natural or legal persons, and national courts making preliminary references where the Treaties and Statute so provide.
subject_matter: Includes preliminary rulings under Article 267 TFEU, annulment review under Article 263 TFEU, treaty-defined direct actions, and appeals or other judicial procedures allocated by the Treaties and Protocol No 3; competence remains case-specific.

notes: Registry seed for CJEU forum competence. Presence of JUR-EU-CJEU never proves jurisdiction, standing, admissibility, legal force, finality, or a merits outcome in a particular case.
